- Initial release of aelf-skills-hub, a meta-skill for discovery, installation, configuration, and routing of all aelf ecosystem skills.
- Provides a unified catalog for domains including wallets (CA/EOA), DEX, NFT marketplace, explorer, and governance.
- Outlines intent-based skill routing, skill bootstrapping, configuration for various clients, and health-check workflows.
- Includes troubleshooting steps and references for catalog schema, intent routing, and security audit.
